posts.name: jffdougan
posts.cooked:
The speculation thread is off and running rampantly. One of my favorite fan communities (for Jim Butcher's Dresden Files) maintains a series of posts archiving various things known to be true about the future of the series (referred to as Words of Jim). My intention is, with help, to try to collect and link similar statements by Christopher, Adam, and Paul regarding the future plans for the game -- for example, that two more expansions are planned after the release of Vengeance (which statement is oft-quoted, although as a latecomer to the party, I haven't ever seen the original).

Any assistance in finding such statements would be appreciated - I'll reserve a post or two below in case of a character limit per post, but then have at it.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
I suspect that it is difficult to find an official quote about there being "exactly two expansions after Vengance" because that is just a paraphrasing of some things we have implied and not an absolute truth (because it depends on what you mean by "expansion"). Things that are true:

1) There is a "regular" expansion after Vengeance.

2) There is a "final" expansion to the card game story arc.

3) There are a few mini-expansions, accessories, and special expansion-like things that we have planned out and are super excited to publish, market willing.
